name: pi-durabletask-mcp

tools.name: init
tools.description: Optional setup diagnostics: reports model availability, provider authentication, permissions and budgets. Use when diagnosing configuration; no init call is needed before delegating. OAuth credentials may refresh.

models.description: Substring to filter the model list, e.g. "deepseek"

cwd.description: Repository you intend to delegate in; picks up its project-local pi model scope

tools.name: spawn
tools.description: Delegate a task to a pi agent running in the background. Returns a sessionId immediately, so nothing blocks. Use `wait` for progress/results, `status` for a snapshot, `steer` to redirect, and `answer` for questions. Use this for anything that might take more than a minute.

prompt.description: The task for the pi agent

attachments.description: Absolute paths of text files appended to the prompt, read by this server, e.g. a diff you wrote to your scratchpad; they may lie outside cwd. At most 20, 256 KiB each, 1 MiB in total; secret paths are refused.

saveTo.description: Absolute file path: when the run finishes, its final text is written there and results show savedTo instead

model.description: Omit for the configured default. Use "provider/modelId" from the models tool to choose another.

thinking.description: Explicit pi thinking level. Omit to use pi's configured/default level.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory for the agent. Required; not the MCP process cwd.

id.description: Your own session id for traceability, e.g. "search-audit-01". 1-64 chars of [A-Za-z0-9._:-], must start alphanumeric, must not already be in use. Defaults to a UUID.

label.description: Free-text note shown in `sessions`, e.g. what this delegate is for

tools.description: Tool allowlist for this delegate. Omit for read, grep, find, ls; [] disables all tools. Permitted on this server: read, grep, find, ls.

nativeMcp.description: Enable Pi native MCP independently of third-party extensions. Requires explicit mcpServers and authorized exact tool names, including codemode/tool_search if used.

mcpServers.description: Names from Pi mcp.json to connect. Required with nativeMcp; other servers are not loaded.

extensions.description: Load pi extensions for this delegate. Off by default; they add startup cost and can misbehave.

durable.description: Default false: memory only, nothing written, gone when this MCP process exits; right for short, cheap, re-runnable work such as reviews, searches and model comparisons. Pass true when the work is long, has external side effects, should survive an MCP restart, or needs disk retention. Memory sessions can follow_up while retained in this process.

retentionDays.description: Durable only: days to keep it on disk after it finishes (default 7, max 365). Set it longer when the user wants to come back to this session later.

maxTurns.description: Maximum model/tool turns for the whole session, cumulative across follow_up; server ceiling 50.

maxDurationMs.description: Wall-clock deadline in milliseconds; server ceiling 900000.

tools.name: spawn_batch
tools.description: Fan out several delegates in one call. Each task inherits the batch-level model, cwd, tools and extensions unless it overrides them. The whole batch is validated before any delegate starts, so a bad model name or a duplicate id fails everything instead of leaving half a fan-out running. Wait for the batch with `wait` and the returned sessionIds, rather than polling `sessions` or one `status` per delegate.

attachments.description: Overrides the batch `attachments` for this task alone; [] attaches nothing

id.description: Session id for this task. Defaults to `idPrefix`-NN, or a UUID.

model.description: Overrides the batch `model` for this task alone

thinking.description: Overrides the batch `thinking` for this task alone

cwd.description: Overrides the batch `cwd` for this task alone

tools.description: Overrides the batch `tools` for this task alone

durable.description: Overrides the batch `durable` for this task alone

retentionDays.description: Overrides the batch `retentionDays` for this task alone

attachments.description: Default for every task in this batch. Absolute paths of text files appended to the prompt, read by this server, e.g. a diff you wrote to your scratchpad; they may lie outside cwd. At most 20, 256 KiB each, 1 MiB in total; secret paths are refused.

saveDir.description: Absolute directory: each finished task's final text is written to <sessionId>.md there

model.description: Default model for every task in this batch

extensions.description: Default extensions setting for every task in this batch

tools.name: run
tools.description: Delegate a task to a pi agent and wait for the final answer. Blocks until done. Client request cancellation aborts the delegate. Prefer spawn plus wait for long work; this is for quick questions. Returns a compact result; use verbose: true for the full snapshot.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Check a background pi session. Returns state, turn count, tools used, latest text, and any pending questions the agent is waiting on. A non-empty `questions` array means it is blocked until you call `answer`. `toolCalls` holds the last 5 calls with shortened arguments and `toolCallCount` the total; pass `verbose: true` for every call with ids and results. Notices include Pi's automatic provider retries. remainingTurns/canFollowUp report state and turn-budget readiness; ownership, capacity and auth are checked by follow_up.

verbose.description: Include tool results and call ids in the trace

tools.name: steer
tools.description: Redirect a running pi agent mid-task. The message lands after its current tool call finishes, before the next model call. Use this instead of aborting when the agent is going the wrong way.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait for delegates without polling in a loop. until: "progress" (default) returns after a new turn/tool call, a pending question, the end, or timeout; pass prior turns/toolCallCount as afterTurns/afterToolCalls. until: "settled" returns only when it finishes or asks a question, so loop on it to get the result. With sessionIds (e.g. a spawn_batch), returns when any one settles ("settled") or all do ("all_settled"): settled/pending ids, continueIds (everything not finished, including sessions waiting for an answer) and a summary per session, with the final text of finished ones and any pending questions. Answer questions, then wait again on continueIds. Single-session results omit the tool trace and configuration by default; use verbose: true for the full snapshot. nextAction is wait, answer or finish; finish means this run ended, so check state/error/termination. Cancelling this wait leaves delegates running; use `abort` to stop one.

sessionId.description: One session; returns its status snapshot

sessionIds.description: Several sessions; returns a summary of each

until.description: Default progress for sessionId, settled for sessionIds

verbose.description: Single session: include the full snapshot, tool results and call ids

tools.name: answer
tools.description: Answer a pending Pi extension UI question. Get requestId from questions[].id in status or wait. The delegate is blocked until you answer; answer only actual pending questions.

value.description: Chosen option, text, or boolean for a confirm

tools.name: follow_up
tools.description: Send another prompt to a delegate that has already finished, keeping everything it read and said. Turns are cumulative: follow_up is refused once maxTurns is used up. The wall-clock limit applies to each run. Memory sessions can continue while retained here; durable sessions can continue after reconnecting while retained on disk. For a live session, use `steer`.

prompt.description: The next turn for this delegate

attachments.description: Absolute paths of text files appended to this prompt, as on spawn

saveTo.description: Absolute file path for this run's final text, as on spawn

tools.name: abort
tools.description: Stop a running pi session. Partial output stays readable via `status`.

tools.name: sessions
tools.description: List pi sessions held by this server, running and finished, plus finished durable sessions stored on disk (`stored`). Up to 50 finished sessions stay loaded; status/wait read stored results without loading, and follow_up loads the conversation. Stored sessions expire by retention. Pass cwd to find this project's history; entries include remainingTurns and state/budget canFollowUp.

cwd.description: Absolute project directory; includes loaded and stored sessions for this cwd

state.description: Filter by state: starting, running, done, aborted, error

verbose.description: Include full text and tool calls

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Drop a finished session from the review history, freeing its id for reuse.

tools.name: models
tools.description: List models this delegate may use from pi's available providers after model filters. Use `filter` to find a provider or model, and `offset`/`limit` to page through long lists. thinkingLevels lists the levels each returned reasoning model accepts; a model absent from it accepts only off.

cwd.description: Picks up a project-local pi model scope

offset.description: First matching model index to return

tools.name: handoff
tools.description: Hand a Pi session over between Claude/Codex windows. save (when the user asks to hand over): record the repository cwd, the sessionId, and a short goal, completed and next. read (when the user asks to pick up a project): returns the latest note for cwd (or the one named), plus resumeHint and howToResume, computed from the session's live state. Follow resumeHint, then use status/wait/follow_up as usual. A note is a summary, not the session's state; it never claims, recovers or deletes a session. remainingTurns/canFollowUp describe state and turn-budget readiness only.

cwd.description: Absolute path of the repository. save: the session's own cwd, exactly as it was spawned with

name.description: Optional label to keep several handoffs per repository; read defaults to the newest

sessionId.description: save: the Pi session to hand over

goal.description: save: what the work is for

completed.description: save: what is done, including results a new window needs

instructions: Delegate to Pi with spawn and an absolute repo cwd. Omit model/tools for the configured model/read-only tools. To get a result, loop wait with until:"settled"; for a batch, wait with sessionIds. Answer pending questions. Steer running work; follow_up finished work while retained. Memory sessions live in this server; durable:true saves across restarts. Use models to choose a model; init is optional setup diagnostics. Cancelling run stops its delegate; cancelling wait only ends the wait. Handing over to another window: handoff save; picking up: handoff read, then follow its resumeHint.
